newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA commodity index falls 0.2 pct in October.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA commodity index falls 0.2 pct in October.

text.p: SYDNEY, Nov 1 (Reuter) The Reserve Bank of Australia's (RBA) October index of commodity prices fell by 0.2 percent in special drawing rights (SDR) terms, RBA said in a statement.
This followed a fall of 0.2 percent in September.
Falls in the prices of wool and aluminium were partly offset by a rise in the price of crude oil, it said.
In Australian dollar terms, the index fell by 0.7 percent, following a fall of 2.1 percent in September, RBA said.
